about: Design #94 section 12's journeys as explicit rows. tests/test_delivery_journey.py computes decisions, required looks and check runs from these rows, holds them to `expected`, and requires AGENTS.md's journey table to state the computed numbers. A `k` count is the number of acceptance criteria, kept symbolic. `optional` rows are counted apart. Every decision kept `after` names the distinct assurance it buys.

label.after: SAFER36, after (evidence with a result identity)

before.what: Read the face: a failed gate chip, a stale evidence chip, 0 of 5 passed (optional checks and history counted)
Open the merge-requirements dialog: its headline is a cancelled run at an older commit
Open the evidence sheet: find the stale / policy-changed pass at the same commit
Work out that the policy change was unrelated context for the next card
Rerun the required check at the unchanged commit
The full suite runs again on the same source and program
Accept each criterion with a note because the Overview asked (no gate enforced it)
Drag to done
Choose merge & clean up

after.what: Read the face: Ready to merge

after.assurance: delivery: the person decides the work lands
shows what will be pushed where before it happens

label.after: SAFER36, after (legacy evidence, no result identity)

before.what: Read the face: a failed gate chip, a stale evidence chip, 0 of 5 passed
Open the merge-requirements dialog: its headline is a cancelled run at an older commit
Open the evidence sheet: find the stale / policy-changed pass
Work out that the policy change was unrelated
Rerun the required check
The full suite runs again
Accept each criterion because the Overview asked
Drag to done
Choose merge & clean up

after.what: Read the face: Checks needed — the pass predates result identities, policy changed

after.assurance: a legacy record cannot prove its result identity, so one fresh run binds it

after.what: One fresh run, which records a result identity; later asks at this commit reuse it

after.assurance: delivery: the person decides the work lands
shows what will be pushed where before it happens

before.what: Drag to in-progress
Start work
The work run asks for the required check after its last commit
If the agent did not ask: open the evidence sheet and rerun the check
The card reaches review; read the gate chip
Review PR
The review run asks for a differently named check in its review root
Accept each criterion because the Overview asked
Drag to done
Choose merge & clean up

after.what: The work run asks for the required check after its last commit
If the agent did not ask: Run required checks
Review PR, offered as the primary action
after.assurance: independent review of the exact commit

after.what: The review asks for the same check at the same commit and is answered by the existing pass
